summary: Internal CLI SSH provisioning fails due to IdP 'email_verified' claim mismatch
description:
Issue summary:
Several engineers intermittently receive 403/authorization failures when attempting to provision ephemeral CLI SSH certificates via the internal provisioning service. Failures began after an IdP attribute mapping rollout that changed how the 'email_verified' flag is emitted for SCIM-provisioned service and user accounts. The provisioning service enforces email_verified=true for certificate issuance; accounts receiving email_verified=false are rejected leading to blocked runbook and SSH access.
impact: Multiple oncall and SRE engineers are blocked from generating ephemeral SSH certs via the CLI, preventing access to internal debug tooling and runbook execution. Estimated ~25 unique users impacted since 2026-03-09 18:00 UTC. No customer-facing outages, but oncall response capability degraded.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Use CLI tool 'redwood-ssh provision' with a user that was recently SCIM-provisioned by IdP.
2) Observe immediate 403/authorization error with error code 'AUTHZ_EMAIL_UNVERIFIED'.
3) Confirm Id token used for the request has 'email_verified' claim present and set to false (or missing).
4) Patch the user's identity in IdP to set email_verified=true and retry; provisioning succeeds.
Notes: Issue reproduced consistently for accounts created after the IdP mapping change (rollout on 2026-03-09 16:30 UTC). Older accounts are unaffected.
logs: 2026-03-10T01:12:43Z auth-proxy ERROR request=abcd1234 user=nicholas.taylor@redwood.test code=403 reason=AUTHZ_EMAIL_UNVERIFIED token_sub=U_9832
2026-03-10T01:12:43Z cli-provisioner WARN provision_request id=req-77a user=nicholas.taylor@redwood.test result=denied detail="email_verified=false"
2026-03-10T01:13:12Z identity-sync INFO scim-sync user=svc-agent-245 mapped_email_verified=false source=okta-attr-map-v2
investigation_notes: 2026-03-10 02:00 UTC: Triage by SRE; correlated increased 403s for SSH provisioning starting 2026-03-09 16:40 UTC.

Checked recent IdP (Okta) deploys and found attribute mapping change (okta-attr-map-v2) that now derives 'email_verified' from an 'verifiedEmails' array rather than a boolean flag. For SCIM-created service accounts the verifiedEmails array is empty -> claim emitted as false/missing.
Provisioner code path expects explicit claim 'email_verified: true' to proceed. There is no fallback for missing/false in current policy enforcement (security decision from 2025-11).
Reproduced locally by minting a test token with email_verified=false; provisioning rejected as expected.
Hypothesis: IdP attribute mapping rollout changed semantics for some identity classes (service accounts), causing newly-provisioned accounts to be treated as unverified.
mitigations: 1) Temporary manual SCIM patch: For impacted service and user accounts, SRE performed a bulk PATCH to set 'email_verified' true for 26 affected identities (completed 2026-03-10 03:45 UTC). This restored access for those users.

2) Short-term policy override: Updated CLI provisioning policy to accept missing 'email_verified' for identities in the 'service-account' namespace only; deployed as emergency config change 2026-03-10 04:20 UTC. (Risk: slightly broader acceptance until IdP mapping stable.)
3) Rolled back Okta attribute mapping to previous version in staging; preparing rollback plan for prod mapping if root-cause patch cannot be applied quickly.
root_cause: An IdP attribute mapping rollout changed how the 'email_verified' claim is generated for SCIM-provisioned identities. For service accounts the mapping produced an empty 'verifiedEmails' array which resulted in 'email_verified' being emitted as false or omitted. The provisioning service enforces email verification as a hard requirement, so those tokens were rejected.
resolution: Applied bulk SCIM patch to set email_verified=true for affected identities and added a targeted policy exception for service-account namespace while a permanent fix is implemented. Coordinated with Identity team to revert the problematic mapping in prod and scheduled a corrected mapping that preserves boolean semantics for service accounts.
permanent_fix_plan: 1) Identity team will roll out corrected attribute mapping (okta-attr-map-v2-fix) that emits explicit boolean for 'email_verified' for all identity classes. Target date: 2026-03-13.
2) Update provisioning service to treat missing 'email_verified' as explicit denial only if token_aud != 'internal-provisioner' (defense-in-depth) and add telemetry for email_verified claim absence.
3) Add an automated SCIM verification job post-provisioning that ensures critical claims are present and alerts if a new identity lacks them.
4) Create an incident postmortem and update runbook to include IdP mapping change checklist and canary verification steps.
Owners: Identity (Aisha Gomez), Provisioning (Jamal Rivera), SRE (Priya Shah).
next_steps: Identity to apply fixed mapping to prod and confirm via canary sync (Aisha) - due 2026-03-13
Provisioning to bake claim-absence telemetry and a non-destructive guardrail by 2026-03-15 (Jamal)
Runbook update and postmortem draft to be completed by 2026-03-17 (Priya)
Remove short-term policy override once IdP fix verified - coordinate timeline after canary results.
